notes: Reverb (sold June 2, 2025) and Elo7 (sold 2023) are past and were not scored. Depop is still operated, so it is scored as current, but its sale to eBay ($1.2B) was agreed Feb 15, 2026 and is expected to close Q2 2026; it will become discontinued operations. Depop is fashion resale, so it was not counted for Creativity. The 2024 seller set-up fee intentionally reduced active seller counts. Workforce demographic statistics (gender, race, disability, LGBTQIA+, 70+ nationalities) are disclosure only and were not counted as activity. The pay equity analysis is biennial, with the next one in 2026. The company says supplier and hiring decisions are made on merit. Platform support for multiple languages/geographies and international sales were not counted (international-operations trap). Trap terms excluded: 'Innovative Technology', engineering 'design', ML 'content', 'brand equity', and 'Community' meaning customer operations teams. The Item 7 excerpt only repeats the overview sentence and adds no evidence. Some Impact details (climate index, SASB, EEO-1) are referred to the IR website, but coverage in Item 1 is enough to judge all themes. The $30M Impact Investment Fund (E6) is the source of the $3M Hope Enterprise investment (E5) and a $3M clean-energy loan; these were not double counted. Environmental activities were not scored except where they independently meet a theme (seller disaster relief).
